UK Minister Appalled Nirav Modi Remains in Britain

British-Indian minister Priti Patel expressed dismay and horror that fugitive diamantaire Nirav Modi is still in the United Kingdom. Patel, who previously signed off on Modi's extradition, stated her feelings on the matter. The coverage focuses on her reaction to Modi's continued presence in the UK.
